schema.description: First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Can be in the past. Defaults to today (UTC).
Last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to `from` plus `days`. At most 30 days after `from`.
Window length in days when `to` is not set, 1 to 30. Defaults to 7. Values outside the range are clamped.
